A Chinese man about 39, hotel chauffeur; sturdy square face, short cropped hair, dark chauffeur's jacket and plain peaked cloth cap without insignia, blurred hotel courtyard background.
A Chinese man about 38, warehouse bookkeeper; narrow face, round tortoiseshell spectacles, neatly combed hair, brown vest and ivory shirt, blurred wooden warehouse office background.
A Chinese man about 29, night-shift electrician; lean face, short tousled hair, indigo work jacket with simple cloth buttons, blurred warehouse electrical workshop background.
